questions.stem:
—I can't find my notebook. ______ you ______ it?
—Yes. I ______ it on the desk just now.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。问句强调'到目前为止是否看见'，用现在完成时Have you seen；答句有明确过去时间状语just now（刚才），用一般过去时saw。A选项问句用一般过去时，只问过去某个时间点，不符合语境；C选项答句用完成时，与just now矛盾；D选项问句用一般过去时，答句用完成时，均错误。口诀：完成时强调'到现在为止'，过去时强调'过去某个具体时间'。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The story ______ the teacher told us yesterday is about a scientist ______ invented the telephone.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词who/which的用法。先行词story是物，在从句中作宾语，用which/that；先行词scientist是人，在从句中作主语，用who/that。B选项第一个空who不能指物；C选项第二个空which不能指人；D选项第一个空who不能指物。技巧：指人用who/whom/that，指物用which/that，人+物用that。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The 2026 World Cup matches ______ in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般将来时的被动语态。主语matches与hold是被动关系（比赛被举行），且2026年是将来时间，用will be held。A选项是主动语态；B选项是一般现在时被动，时态不对；D选项是一般过去时被动，时态不对。被动语态结构：be + 过去分词，注意时态变化。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—How long have you ______ the book?
—Only two days. I ______ it from the library last Friday.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与过去时的区别以及延续性动词用法。how long问时间段，需与延续性动词连用，keep是延续性动词（借了多久），borrow是瞬间动词（借的动作），第一空填kept；第二空有last Friday，用一般过去时borrowed。B选项动词用反了；C选项第一空borrow不能与how long连用；D选项第二空kept不能与last Friday连用。技巧：how long/ since/ for + 时间段，动词要用延续性的（keep/have），瞬间动词（borrow/buy/die）要转换。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The old building was demolished to make way for a new shopping center. The word 'demolished' probably means ______.
questions.explanation: 本题考查通过上下文猜测词义。根据'to make way for a new shopping center'（为新建购物中心让路）可知，旧建筑应该是被'拆除/毁坏'了。A选项built（建造）相反；C选项painted（粉刷）与让路无关；D选项sold（出售）不符合语境。词义猜测技巧：根据前后因果关系（为新建而让路→旧建筑被拆除）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights when you leave the classroom to save electricity.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。根据'leave the classroom'（离开教室）和'save electricity'（省电）可知应'关灯'，turn off关闭。A选项turn on打开，相反；C选项turn up调大（音量）；D选项turn down调小（音量）。短语动词要熟记搭配：turn on/off（开/关电器），turn up/down（调大/小音量）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The weather was so ______ that we decided to stay at home instead of going camping.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换及前缀用法。系动词was后需形容词，根据'stay at home'（呆在家）可知天气'不好'，un-是表示否定的前缀，unpleasant（不舒服的）。A选项pleasant（舒适的），与语境相反；C选项pleasure是名词；D选项please是动词。技巧：un-前缀表示'不'，如happy-unhappy, usual-unusual。

questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a recycling project to help protect the environment. The project was designed by a group of students who wanted to make a difference.

At first, many students were not interested in the idea. They thought recycling was too much work and wouldn't change anything. However, after the first week, everything began to change.

The student team placed special bins around the school. Each bin was ______ (8) for different types of waste - paper, plastic, and glass. They also put up posters to explain why recycling was important. "Every small action counts," the posters said.

The results were amazing. In just one month, we collected over 500 kilos of recyclable materials. Teachers and students were ______ (9) by the success. The money earned from selling these materials was used to buy new books for the school library.

What surprised everyone most was how students' attitudes changed. People started to think more carefully about their daily habits. Instead of throwing everything away, they would ______ (10) check if an item could be recycled.

The project has taught us an important lesson: protecting the environment doesn't require big changes. It starts with small steps in our ______ (11) life. As one student said, "Once you start, it becomes a habit, and then it feels strange not to recycle."

Now, other schools in our city want to copy our ______ (12). We are happy to share our experience and help them start their own recycling programs.
questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理及固定搭配。根据'different types of waste'（不同类型的垃圾）可知，每个垃圾桶被'标记/贴上标签'用于特定垃圾，be labeled for为固定搭配，意为'被标记为'。A选项used for被用于，不太准确；C选项chosen被选择；D选项made for为...制作。结合上下文，学生团队放置垃圾桶并'标记'分类最合理。

questions.group_passage:
Do you often feel tired during the day? The answer might be in your sleep habits. Scientists have discovered that good sleep is not just about the number of hours you spend in bed, but also about the quality of your rest.

When we sleep, our brains are very busy. They are organizing memories and cleaning out waste products. This process is essential for learning. Studies show that students who get enough sleep perform better on tests than those who stay up late studying. "Sleep is like a superpower for your brain," says Dr. Li Ming, a sleep researcher.

However, many teenagers don't get enough sleep. One major reason is the use of electronic devices. The blue light from phones and computers tricks our brains into thinking it is still daytime. This makes it harder to fall asleep. Experts recommend turning off all screens at least one hour before bedtime.

Another important factor is routine. Going to bed and waking up at the same time every day helps your body develop a healthy rhythm. Even on weekends, try not to change your schedule by more than one hour. This consistency helps you feel more energetic during the week.

So what can you do if you have trouble sleeping? First, create a relaxing bedtime routine. Reading a book or listening to calm music can help. Second, keep your bedroom cool and dark. Finally, avoid caffeine in the afternoon and evening.

Remember, good sleep habits don't just help you feel better - they can improve your grades and overall health. Sweet dreams!
questions.stem: According to the passage, what happens when we sleep?
options: C. We don't need to breathe.
D. Our bodies grow taller quickly.

questions.group_passage:
Starting a healthy lifestyle might seem difficult, but it's actually quite simple if you take it step by step. Here are some tips to help you get started.

(17)______ Eating a good breakfast gives you energy for the whole morning. Try to include fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your meals. Avoid too much junk food like chips and soda.

Regular exercise is also important. You don't need to run marathons to be healthy. (18)______ Walking to school, playing basketball with friends, or even dancing in your room counts as exercise. The key is to find something you enjoy so that you will stick with it.

(19)______ Many teenagers stay up late using their phones, which makes them tired in class. Try to get 8-9 hours of sleep each night. Put your phone away before bedtime and read a book instead.

Finally, remember that nobody is perfect. (20)______ What matters is that you keep trying. If you eat an unhealthy meal or miss a workout, don't give up. Just make a better choice next time.

A healthy lifestyle is a journey, not a destination. Start with small changes, and soon they will become habits that last a lifetime.
options: A. First, pay attention to your diet.
B. However, getting enough sleep is equally crucial.
C. For example, you can take a 20-minute walk every day.
D. As a result, you will feel more energetic every day.
E. You will make mistakes sometimes, and that's okay.
questions.explanation: 本题考查段落主题句。空格后内容讲'吃早餐、包含水果蔬菜、避免垃圾食品'，都是关于饮食的，A选项'首先，注意你的饮食'作为主题句最合适。B选项讲睡眠，是下一段内容；C选项是举例，但本段已有具体例子；D选项是结果，但后文是具体建议；E选项讲犯错，是最后一段内容。技巧：选句子填空要注意段落主题一致性，首句通常是主题句。

questions.explanation: 本题考查转折过渡。前文讲了饮食和运动，本段讲睡眠，B选项'然而，获得足够睡眠同样重要'用However转折引出另一个要点。A选项已用于17题；C选项是举例；D选项是结果；E选项是最后一段内容。技巧：however/equally crucial用于引入同等重要的另一个方面，注意段落间的并列过渡关系。
questions.label: 短文填空

questions.group_passage:
Starting a healthy lifestyle might seem difficult, but it's actually quite simple if you take it step by step. Here are some tips to help you get started.

(17)______ Eating a good breakfast gives you energy for the whole morning. Try to include fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your meals. Avoid too much junk food like chips and soda.

Regular exercise is also important. You don't need to run马拉松 to be healthy. (18)______ Walking to school, playing basketball with friends, or even dancing in your room counts as exercise. The key is to find something you enjoy so that you will stick with it.

(19)______ Many teenagers stay up late using their phones, which makes them tired in class. Try to get 8-9 hours of sleep each night. Put your phone away before bedtime and read a book instead.

Finally, remember that nobody is perfect. (20)______ What matters is that you keep trying. If you eat an unhealthy meal or miss a workout, don't give up. Just make a better choice next time.

A healthy lifestyle is a journey, not a destination. Start with small changes, and soon they will become habits that last a lifetime.
options: A. First, pay attention to your diet.
B. However, getting enough sleep is equally crucial.
C. For example, you can take a 20-minute walk every day.
D. As a result, you will feel more energetic every day.
E. You will make mistakes sometimes, and that's okay.
questions.explanation: 本题考查逻辑衔接。前文说'nobody is perfect'（没人完美），E选项'你有时会犯错，这没关系'与之呼应，后文'重要的是坚持尝试'也与之衔接。A、B、C已用；D选项是结果，与犯错语境不符。技巧：代词指代和逻辑连贯，nobody is perfect对应make mistakes，形成语义连贯。
